known_limitations: The search is systematic and citation-chained but is not a registered systematic review.
Absence of an exact match cannot support first, unique, or unprecedented wording.
Several arXiv primary pages, including the closest 2026 works, may later receive proceedings versions and require refresh.

The repository validate_related_work.py is currently an artifact-level wrapper; deterministic CSV/YAML/cross-file checks were used, and the independent reviewer must decide whether a dedicated semantic validator is required.
Search saturation is provisional and requires refresh before final claim freeze and submission.
unexpected_findings: SkillSmith occupies the broad claim that a stronger model can compile reusable executable runtime interfaces for smaller models; the flagship must not present that architecture as novel.
Ontology-to-tools occupies the broad claim that formal semantics can be compiled into typed executable tools for LLM agents.
Compiled Memory occupies broad compile-not-train rhetoric even without trusted formal execution.
Recent ACL 2026 work trains Qwen2.5-3B to use Prolog and occupies broad small-model-plus-Prolog positioning.
The remaining defensible contribution is the matched causal decomposition of semantic placement, four-state epistemic preservation, copying/structure controls, and independent layer evaluation.
